IlexForestApprenticeIntroText:
Oh, man… My boss
is going to be steaming…

The FARFETCH'D
that CUTS trees

for charcoal took
off on me.

I can't go looking
for it here in the ILEX FOREST.

It's too big, dark
and scary for me…
IlexForestApprenticeAfterText:
Wow! Thanks a
whole bunch!

My boss's #MON
won't obey me be- cause I don't have a BADGE.
Text_CharcoalMasterIntro:
Ah! My FARFETCH'D!

You found it for
us, kid?

Without it, we
wouldn't be able

to CUT trees for
charcoal.

Thanks, kid!

Now, how can I
thank you…

I know! Here, take
this.
Text_CharcoalMasterOutro:
That's the CUT HM.
Teach that to a

#MON to clear
small trees.

Of course, you
have to have the

GYM BADGE from
AZALEA to use it.
Text_CharcoalMasterTalkAfter:
Do you want to
apprentice as a

charcoal maker
with me?

You'll be first-
rate in ten years!
Text_HeadbuttIntro:
What am I doing?

I'm shaking trees
using HEADBUTT.

It's fun. Here,
you try it too!
Text_HeadbuttOutro:
Rattle trees with
HEADBUTT. Some- times, sleeping #MON fall out.
Text_IlexForestLass:
Did something
happen to the forest's guardian?
IlexForestSignpostText:
ILEX FOREST is
so overgrown with

trees that you
can't see the sky.

Please watch out
for items that may have been dropped.
Text_IlexForestShrine:
ILEX FOREST
SHRINE…

It's in honor of
the forest's protector…
Text_ShrineCelebiEvent:
ILEX FOREST
SHRINE…

It's in honor of
the forest's protector…

Oh? What is this?

It's a hole.
It looks like the

GS BALL would fit
inside it.

Want to put the GS
BALL here?
Text_KurtCaughtCelebi:
Whew, wasn't that
something!

{PLAYER}, that was
fantastic. Thanks!

The legends about
that SHRINE were real after all.

I feel inspired by
what I just saw.

It motivates me to
make better BALLS!

I'm going!
BugCatcherWayneSeenText:
Don't sneak up on
me like that!

You frightened a
#MON away!
BugCatcherWayneAfterBattleText:
A #MON I've
never seen before

fell out of the
tree when I used HEADBUTT.

I ought to use
HEADBUTT in other places too.
